digest.component_or_area: reconciler Jira-family vendor-adapter seam and ADR 0055 amending 0035
propositions: A new ADR 0055 must amend (not replace) ADR 0035 to record the jira_family sub-seam, its two parameterizing contracts, the shared-jira provenance decision, and the pycontribs/jira extra-gated dependency.

The Backend port under-declares what the core requires: TicketTransport declares six members while the core reaches for twenty-one distinct transport members, twelve absent from the DC transport, causing a silent live crash while isinstance checks, the contract suite, and 1636 unit tests all pass.

The ADR must state that ADR 0035's 'the contract suite certifies a backend' claim is conditional on the port being complete and typed, since an unannotated transport parameter hides the gap from mypy.
RemoteRef.instance is never constructed in production code, so the ADR must present deployment-distinguishing-by-instance as intended design with the gap named and ticketed, not as existing reality.

ADR 0035's 'first real second backend out of scope' claim is falsified in multiple sites (layout diagram, prose, Decision item 6, and Consequences), all of which must be corrected and cited by filename because three files share the number 0035.

docs/user-guide.md and docs/architecture.md must document the DC least-privilege PAT expectation, allow_insecure, ca_bundle, resolved_statuses, the reconciler.backend choice, the jira-datacenter extra, and verification via the amd64-only Docker harness in a native x86_64 CI job.
